Gouni Jacobi At the hospital, did you get a paper from the person who did the initial registration, like a carbon copy on flimsy paper? If yes, your child was assigned a TZ number already and the MH appointment is just to complete the registration and give the child a proper birth certificate.
If you did not receive the paper, that may indicate that you are not long enough in the process to qualify for automatic registration. In that case, it might take a lot longer than just a few days because you might have to go through a court and undergo DNA testing.
